grants.description: Verify your identity to access the Carer's Assessment service
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and ensure you receive the correct assessment from your local authority

grants.description: Share information about the person you care for
grants.purpose: To understand your caring role and the support needs that arise from it

grants.description: Share details about your caring responsibilities and how they affect you
grants.purpose: To assess your support needs and identify what help would be most beneficial

grants.description: Share information about your own health and wellbeing
grants.purpose: To understand how caring affects your health and what support you need to stay well

grants.description: Allow local authority to contact your GP for relevant health information
grants.purpose: To verify health information that may affect your ability to continue caring

grants.description: Allow local authority to share your information with support services and care providers
grants.purpose: To arrange respite care, support groups, grants, or other services identified in your assessment

revocation.mechanism: Contact your local authority social care team or revoke through your council account
revocation.effect: Assessment will be cancelled and no support services will be arranged. Existing support may be reviewed.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide medical information on your behalf. Agent cannot consent to treatment or care arrangements. Agent cannot make decisions about the person you care for. Final approval of support plan requires your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot revoke consent on your behalf.
